carnival illusionist, near-future, rendered as charcoal concept art moodboard, a cinematic grade, frosted glass

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a punchy saturated candy palette with hard primaries. Lighting reference: LED tube accents in two contrasting hues placed in depth.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.
